notes.title: Evil lurks in the darkness.
notes.notes:
Whilst the icy wasteland of northern Quebec hosts many wild animals, none is as dangerous and cunning as a fellow man. In the absence of government control, spurred on by the ongoing weather crisis, strange figures stalk the land—their faces covered, their guns loaded, their minds eager to kill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/737c77d06a7aebb9f8fffefbebc85a3edb9019c2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Groups of 2-5
[*] Rather heavily armored
[*] Winter outdoor apparel (crampons, snowshoes)
[*] Non-standard uniforms: not a military unit, so the outfits vary in color and style, yet they are practical winter combat clothes
[*] They accessorize: wearing custom hats, ushankas, balaclavas, additional weapons, gadgets, pockets, satchels, etc.
[*] Besides combat equipment, they carry snacks, outdoor stoves, rations, matches, cigarettes, and other essentials
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/3edd4a5e90c3ceebd73141812b5b797e290fa409.png[/img]

Paramilitary uniforms and foreign weaponry reveal that these are no ordinary hunters. Following the dissolution of their original unit at the conclusion of the Angolan Bush War, the mercenaries of the former Voorveld Battalion found themselves seeking a new employer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/4a1721dde45c69ede69f8e6bf1542adc52103405.png[/img]

 Reorganizing under a new banner, this time under a very lucrative contract for a certain three-letter intelligence agency, they now form a conveniently deniable asset sent to investigate and extract resources as well as personnel related to the research project underway in the vicinity of Mt. Gosford.

[url=https://discord.gg/j4ySVzdCYQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/036ba4a93a8631402a8891360ec98c103774b019.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: It's time for a driving...
notes.notes:
Henry controls an All Terrain Vehicle specializing in crossing a multitude of wild environments, especially the more snowy type that we can expect to encounter in ICEBOUND. Affectionally called "The Beast" by its owner, clearly referring to its enormous size and intimidating appearance, is still indeed a beast when crossing the icy ravines and forested mountains of the northern Appalachians. Connected to the tractor, which serves as Henry's de facto living space, is the cargo section of the vehicle. This section provides ample space to help Henry deliver supplies to those in need and to store what he might need on his journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/ffce58eaac5e0899a16fb7d5bbd9a8f4b8c71103.jpg[/img]

The ATV offers some limited amphibious abilities, with which will aid us in crossing treacherous, ice-covered swamps ribboned with narrow, post-glacial lakes, dark coniferous forests, as well as rocky passes of low and medium mountains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/74aba8353dfc696dee6865d38687bfc931d1bbf3.jpg[/img]

The Beast won't have an easy task ahead of it, and it has most certainly seen better days. Henry will be the only person around to perform even the most basic maintenance, such as replacing broken tracks and worn, under-performing engine components. Repairing mechanical damage to the body, chassis and electrical subsystems will prove to be a constant problem, interferring in our mission. It's a good thing we'll have the opportunity to visit the occasional abandoned mechanic shops and to scavenge certain encountered vehicles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/1bb0bbe64fc04f5040780cab3247c51921c6e088.jpg[/img]

To perform repairs Henry needs to be in a good shape himself. The biting cold certainly won't make things easier and keeping the engine running, and thus heating, will make the difference between keeping your only friend - The Beast - in a working condition and protecting you from both the cold and the fauna, and making a mad dash to the closest place of opportunity. Remember, that should you choose to get there on foot, you might encounter not just wolves...

notes.title: A regular wilderness firefighter?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/b390d40ebc99149c9447bda0060925180835b725.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Name: Henry Beauchamp
[*] Age: 45
[*] Occupation: wilderness firefighter
[*] Nationality: Canadian 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/f50898462e0200ca059d77e567cf39986eb6b662.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/e877d3a0a860e0ed100d3a203932cc0065586df3.png[/img]

Henry's life story is steeped in both heroism and hardship. A combat veteran of a foreign conflict, Henry returned to Canada carrying the burdens of war. He wanted to lead a peaceful life alongside his wife and son. Seeking solace in the wilderness, he dedicated himself to fighting wildfires in the remote forests of Canada. Over a decade into his firefighting career, Henry has faced numerous life-threatening situations and witnessed the loss of fellow firefighters, experiences that have only solidified his commitment to his profession.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/f9b5a0949d122eef704973b3c05615bb0590e087.jpg[/img]

Beyond his firefighting duties, Henry is an accomplished survivalist and skilled mechanic, using his technical expertise to maintain and repair firefighting equipment, ensuring it performs in extreme conditions. His skills and steadfast dedication to helping others survive and respect the wilderness have earned him deep respect in his community.


[url=https://discord.gg/j4ySVzdCYQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/036ba4a93a8631402a8891360ec98c103774b019.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are absolutely thrilled by the overwhelming response to ICEBOUND and cannot express enough gratitude for your support. Your enthusiasm fuels this incredible adventure, making it even more extraordinary.

Take a glimpse into Henry’s world—the late '80s wilderness where his skills as a firefighter, mechanic and survivalist will be put to the ultimate test. Prepare for a riveting journey filled with mechanical challenges, scavenging, environmental puzzles and vast expanses ripe for exploration.

notes.title: Snowrunner to get some competition in this survival driving sim
notes.notes:
It's certainly fun to fire up something like Forza Motorsport and attempt to set a new land speed record in one of the flashiest modern supercars on the market. Still, speed isn't everything, and as Snowrunner has taught us, going slow can be its own kind of fun - especially when it means carefully navigating over terrain that would instantly kill the average Bugatti. There's a new game called Icebound lining up to take a bite from the Snowrunner pie, and it's throwing in a few new elements to keep things exciting.
